2026-08-01 Japan

Japan Day 8

Rachel here!

Breakfast

For breakfast, we got the fruit smoothies from 7 Eleven again, unfortunately we only remembered to get a photo a little late.

Cooking Class

After breakfast, we had a cooking class! The class was extremely well done - probably the best cooking class I have ever done. We made 8 dishes and the teachers took time to explain each step to us. After making everything, we got to eat our food and it was delicious!

Shibuya Crossing

We had some time before our next activity, so we went to Shibuya Crossing, the Times Square of Tokyo.

We also got to see the Hachiko statue, which is a statue of a dog that waited for his owner at the train station every day for years, even after his owner passed away.

Escape Room

Then we got to try a Japanese escape room! We knew going in that it would be very hard. And it was. The room had a 9% success rate, we made it almost to the end but we didn't quite win. It was still fun to play.

Sake Market

Sake is a Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice. We found a place near where we were that offered all you can drink for 30 minutes for $15. This was a very fun way to try lots of different drinks for a very reasonable price. Sebastián liked the fruit sakes, and I liked anything sweet.

Karaoke

We ended the night with karaoke and had a lot of fun singing our favorite songs together (while a little tipsy).

Dinner

We got dinner from a small restaurant - ramen and gyozas.
